tasks.AskQuestions: Engage the child in a conversation by asking simple questions about herself.
tasks.Costume: Ask about or show interest in the child's costume if it is relevant.
tasks.CountToTen: Instruct the child to count to ten as a basic icebreaker activity.
tasks.DressHerself: Encourage the child to demonstrate how she dresses herself, which can be an interesting icebreaker.
tasks.StateName: Request the child to state her name for identification purposes.
